rules: This amendment was frozen before any M01-M08 historical maker economic output was observed.
The public Regular User USDT-M fee schedule replaces only the unresolved personal-fee prerequisite for historical M6 economics.
It does not claim these are the user's personal account fees.
No BNB discount, VIP discount, liquidity-provider rebate, or optimistic maker rebate may be used in canonical M6.
If future personal fees are lower, canonical M6 must not be rerun with lower fees to rescue or improve results.
If future personal fees are higher than this frozen schedule, live deployment remains blocked until the higher real fees are separately evaluated.
All M01-M08, queue, latency, sizing, accounting, multiplicity, bootstrap, terminal-flatten, and eligibility rules from M5 remain unchanged.
